office_does: Okanogan County Superior Court is the county's general-jurisdiction trial court for felonies, civil disputes, family and dependency cases; its two judges are elected countywide.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Rachel Hong, appointed by Gov. Bob Ferguson in July 2025 after Judge Robert Grim resigned, is the only candidate for the two years left in the term.

candidates.summary: Okanogan County Superior Court judge since July 2025 (appointed), after nearly 15 years as law clerk to U.S. District Judge Barbara Rothstein and work as a litigator; the only candidate.
highlights: Appointed by Gov. Bob Ferguson effective July 3, 2025, from six applicants [S2][S4][S5]
Clerked for U.S. District Judge Barbara J. Rothstein for more than a decade [S1][S3]
Litigated civil and criminal cases in state and federal courts [S1][S3]
